_comment: DeepSeek Harness does not auto-load an MCP server file. Replace <ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_SKILL> with the absolute path of adapters/deepseek-harness/skills/bim-bridge/scripts (the launcher's own directory), then translate this server into an '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client' row in a DSH profile's Cordis configuration. Get-BimBridgeDshMcpConfig.ps1 -Style cordis-patch emits that row directly, with cwd equal to that same directory. cwd must exist wherever the bundle is copied: DeepSeek Harness hands it straight to the stdio spawn and a missing directory fails the spawn.
